titel: L25005 – Construction of a charging hub for electric buses in Via Mitolo, Bari
kurzbeschreibung: In Bari, as part of a three-year framework agreement, a charging hub for electric buses is being planned and built in Via Mitolo. The contract covers the execution design and construction for high-voltage systems and associated infrastructure.
wettbewerb_art: Open procedure for construction works with integrated execution design (framework agreement)
gewinner: R.T.I. EUROSISTEMI S.R.L. (lead) – A.P. COSTRUZIONI S.R.L. – DIDACO S.R.L.
gewinner_rolle: Construction company/bidding consortium for execution design and construction
gewinner_kontakt:
Contract value: 6.051.194,75 EUR (excluding VAT)
EUROSISTEMI S.R.L., Via dei Calafati - Z.I. n. 11-11/A, 70056 Molfetta (BA), Italy, E-mail: eurosistemimolfetta@pec.it, Tel.: +39 0803358017, www.eurosistemimolfetta.com
A.P. COSTRUZIONI S.R.L., VI° Traversa Sant'Antonio n. 18, 81030 Casapesenna (CE), Italy, E-mail: apcostruzioni@pec.sinapsis-srl.net, Tel.: +39 0818921340
DIDACO S.R.L., Via V. Flacco n. 20, 76123 Andria (BT), Italy, E-mail: didaco@pec.it, Tel.: +39 0883262919, www.didacosrl.it
projektbeteiligte:
Client: Comune di Bari - Ripartizione Stazione Unica Appaltante, Contratti e Gestione Lavori Pubblici (local authority), Via Garruba 51, 70122 Bari, Italy, E-mail: contrattiappalti.comunebari@pec.rupar.puglia.it
Contractor/consortium (RTI): EUROSISTEMI S.R.L. (lead, electrical/infrastructure construction company), A.P. COSTRUZIONI S.R.L. (construction company), DIDACO S.R.L. (construction/electrical and infrastructure construction company)
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Infrastructure project for a charging hub, focus on high-voltage lines and technical equipment, no bridge or long-span structure
- No indication of complex building or special structures, rather classic infrastructure/plant construction
- Outside the DACH region and without a particular sbp focus (no bridge, no stadium, no major cultural building)
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- Project location Italy, no German checking engineer service tendered
- Focus on high-voltage and plant construction, no complex buildings or bridges with high checking demand for sbp
- Framework agreement with contract already awarded, no obvious need for an external checking engineer
baukosten_erklaerung: Derived: contract value 6.051.194,75 EUR, rounded to 6,000,000 EUR for cost groups 300/400 (building/plant construction share)
naechste_schritte: No active acquisition recommended. Record the project internally only as a reference for international bus depot/charging infrastructure projects, but do not initiate further steps for structural design or checking engineer services.
notes: Three-year framework agreement for execution design and construction of a charging hub for electric buses in Bari (Via Mitolo). CPV 45231400 (construction work for high-voltage power lines) indicates a strong MEP/infrastructure focus. Award criteria: 80% quality (design, execution, site organisation, sustainability, certifications) and 20% price. Not an architectural or structural competition, but a construction tender with integrated execution design.
